# 2 Baruch Chapter 29 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And he answered and said to me: As for what will be at that time — those who will be living on the earth will rejoice.

**2** And it will come to pass at that time that the treasury of manna will descend again from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have arrived at the consummation of the times.

**3** And it will come to pass at that time that the reservoirs of dew will be opened, and from above they will descend, and from below they will spring up; and they will again eat of the fruit of the earth.

**4** And it will come to pass at that time that Behemoth will be revealed from his place, and Leviathan will ascend from the sea — those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation and have kept until that time; and then they will be food for all who remain.

**5** The earth also will yield her fruit ten-thousandfold, and on one vine there will be a thousand branches, and each branch will produce a thousand clusters, and each cluster will produce a thousand grapes, and each grape will produce a cor of wine.

**6** And those who are hungry will rejoice; and moreover they will see wonders every day.

**7** For winds will go out before me every morning bearing the fragrance of aromatic fruits, and at the close of day clouds of healing dew will descend.

**8** And it will come to pass at that time that the treasury of manna will descend again from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because they have arrived at the end of the times.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The messianic banquet with Behemoth and Leviathan (v.4) is a widespread second-temple motif. The hyperbolic vineyard (v.5) echoes Irenaeus's citation of Papias. Note the apparent doublet in vv.2/8.*
